title: Teacher Salary Schedule & Lifetime Earnings Projector
description: Project lifetime K-12 teacher earnings from a step-and-lane salary schedule. Model step advancement, COLA, and planned lane changes (e.g., earning a master's) to reveal career earnings trajectory and final-year salary (FAS) for pension planning.
data_vintage: BLS OEWS 2025 (illustrative presets only; district grid user-supplied)
regulatory_citations: BLS OEWS May 2025 (elementary teacher wage percentiles — used for illustrative presets only; actual district salary schedule is user-supplied)

mcp_tool_definition.name: project_teacher_salary_schedule
mcp_tool_definition.description: Project lifetime teacher earnings from a step-and-lane schedule. Returns year-by-year salary path, lifetime earnings total, baseline (no lane changes), lane-change uplift, and final-year salary for pension FAS input.

annualStepIncrease.description: Dollar increase per step of service
